# Gem: a six-sided faceted gem 0.26 across and 0.36 tall, pivot at its foot. A pool of game bones: the game
# floats, spins and pops them.
new
material new Gem --base-color 0.984 0.969 0.953 --no-slot
add mesh uv-sphere --name Gem --segments 6 --rings 3 --radius 0.13 --location 0 0 0.18
scale 1 1 1.4
apply --scale
material assign Gem
shade flat
export gem.glb
